focal_entities.audience: a developer of a Claude Code plugin whose steps have AI make documents or code, deciding whether to use turn and then calling it from a step

goal_orientation.purpose: the work is rewritten in place to the decisions, which now follow dev/architecture.md: questions sent to the calling AI by message, the run going on with the answer; a stopped run going on from its last step; turn called from where two layers of agents remain; it keeps all else it says now. deciding whether to use turn, then installing it and calling it from a step of their plugin, as the example shows
